def transform(grid):
    # A solid full-width line separates the stencil from the image.
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
    stencil = grid[:sep]
    image = grid[sep + 1:]
    if len(stencil) != len(image):
        raise ValueError('expected equal-sized stencil and image')
    return [[2 if stencil[r][c] != 0 and image[r][c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(len(stencil[r]))] for r in range(len(stencil))]
PY
